name: slack-radar
description: A Slack triage crew that remembers. Watches the channels you choose, classifies every new message as a bug report, feature request, question, already-answered or noise with a priority, links clusters to existing GitHub issues and PRs, notices when a thread looks resolved, and posts a daily digest — keeping everything in a local ledger so nothing is triaged twice.
author: iamwhatever
highlights: One crew for every channel you configure: new messages are classified by category and priority with a one-line summary
Its own per-channel cursor, independent of your Slack read state
Flags threads that look resolved for the crew to judge; code never closes an item on its own
Clusters of reports are investigated by a read-only subagent that links matching GitHub issues and PRs
Daily digest posted to a channel you choose, built from the ledger's public fields
The bot token and channel settings live in the gateway's encrypted vault, out of every agent's reach

args: import os,runpy,sys;h=[os.environ.get('KIROCREW_HOME',''),os.path.expanduser('~/.kiro/crew'),os.path.expanduser('~/.kirocrew')];p=next((os.path.join(d,'apps','slack-radar','backend','mcp_server.py') for d in h if d and os.path.isfile(os.path.join(d,'apps','slack-radar','backend','mcp_server.py'))),None);p or sys.exit('slack-radar: mcp_server.py not found under the crew home');runpy.run_path(p,run_name='__main__')

crons.name: daily-digest
crons.message: Call the slack_radar_request_digest tool exactly once with no arguments, then stop. Do not read the ledger, do not compose anything, and produce NO other output - the Slack Radar crew composes the digest in its own session.

useCases: Triage support and feedback channels continuously, link reports to existing GitHub work, and get one daily summary instead of reading every channel.
configuration: Create a Slack app with a bot user, grant channels:history, groups:history, channels:read and chat:write, install it to your workspace, invite the bot to each channel, then paste its xoxb- Bot User OAuth Token and the channel IDs in Settings.
